game.title: Scarlet Nexus
game.blurb: Action RPG with psychokinetic combat and two playable leads, Yuito and Kasane, from Bandai Namco Entertainment, released 2021-06-25. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story as seen through both leads, and its endings. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: Bonds and Allies
chapters.summary: Bond Episodes and Bond Levels with each ally, gifts and reviving each other.

chapters.title: Psychokinesis and Combat
chapters.summary: Throwing objects, SAS, Brain Field, Brain Crush, perfect dodges, and Combo, Assault and guardian visions.

chapters.title: Brain Map and Growth
chapters.summary: Learning Brain Map skills, raising the EXP bonus and saving up kins.

chapters.title: Quests, Items and Fashion
chapters.summary: Quests, the Enemy Compendium, item exchange and visual equipment.

StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for this game (API returned missing for "Scarlet Nexus"; "SCARLET NEXUS" also missing). scarlet-nexus.fandom.com answers the API, but its game page has only 3 linked pages ("Kasane Randall", "Yuito Sumeragi" and "Scarlet Nexus (TV Series)"); scarletnexus.fandom.com gave no page; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "HE4R" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 775500. 13 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter, though some (for example "One Lost in Madness", "Protect!", "Baki-s" and "Wheels Gone Wild") may be side goals. RAWG lists a playtime of only 7 hours, which looks low.
